## Complete decks

The starter is the file to copy when beginning a presentation. The hostile
specimen is a worked example and acceptance test, not another layout system.

::: {.lc-gallery-grid}

::: {.lc-gallery-card}

## Hostile specimen

Long titles, equations, code, images, native controls, speaker notes, live
Bonito routes, resize, pointer, and print placeholders in one acceptance deck.

[Open presentation →](specimen.html){.lc-gallery-link}

## Starter deck

The smallest complete source: one static layout and one persistent live-view
boundary, with no scientific or broker dependency in the deck itself.

[Open starter →](starter.html){.lc-gallery-link}
:::

:::

## Reusable slide layouts

These six layouts arrange the content **inside one slide**. They are not
standalone decks or Bonito widgets. Use any of them in the starter, and mix
layouts freely between slides. **Preview layout** opens its example in the
specimen; **Copy slide Markdown** opens a ready-to-copy slide block.

::: {.lc-gallery-grid}

::: {.lc-gallery-card}
[ONE REGION]{.lc-gallery-label}

## Narrow authoring grammar

Copy `presentations/starter.qmd` to begin a deck. Each slide consists of a
level-two heading, one named layout, and its required number of slots.

```{.markdown shortcodes=false}
## Slide title

::: {.lcm-layout-feature-sidebar}
::: {.lcm-slot}
{{< bonito route="/widgets/control-panel"
    title="Cable controls"
    height="100%"
    public-url="/widgets/control-panel" >}}
:::
::: {.lcm-slot .lcm-slot-panel}
Ordinary Quarto content.
:::
:::
```

The layout filter validates names and slot counts. Raw slide scripts, styles,
and nested sections are rejected. Live viewports require an explicit public
playground URL so print and presenter surfaces always have a useful fallback.
